page.notes: The right part of the page is blanked out, and the lower part is cut off. Partial text at the top right ("lib.xi, Paterc. lib.i, Frontin.") belongs to the right column and is not transcribed as running text. Some references are doubtful in the scan. Marginal reference markers "ID LIX", "ID LXX" etc. at the left edge are printed in the left margin and are transcribed here at the start of their rows. Small italic note at left margin ("rectius Ralstd Lannar.") is illegible. Column breaks and cut areas are not described. The line "XCVI Arre-" is a hyphenated line end continuing on the cut-off part.
